co_access_fund_trailhead_the.name: Access Fund Trailhead, The
co_access_fund_trailhead_the.note: Skyward (its Unaweep page redirects to its Grand Junction page) names Feb-Jun and Sep-Nov; Visit Grand Junction says spring and fall best for Unaweep; Feb dropped for the high canyon.

mn_ely_s_peak_bouldering.name: Ely's Peak
mn_ely_s_peak_bouldering.note: Only general spring/fall visitor advice and dry weather; no month-naming climbing source.

wa_lower_town_wall.name: Lower Town Wall
wa_lower_town_wall.note: Sources disagree: one calls Index a summer hotspot, forums say Jul-Aug too hot and humid, late Sept best, climbable year-round; no agreed months.

wv_bozoo.name: Bozoo
wv_bozoo.note: HELD by reviewer: state / New River region sources, nothing about this crag. WV Tourism: late Apr-mid Jun and mid Sep-early Nov; NPS New River Gorge: late Apr-mid Jun and mid Sep-late Oct. Both speak for the state / New River region, not Bozoo by name.

ar_northwest_arkansas_nwa_region.name: Northwest Arkansas (NWA) Region
ar_northwest_arkansas_nwa_region.note: No month-naming source found; only year-round access and cold-winter notes.

ca_hwy_33_ojai.name: Hwy 33/Ojai
ca_hwy_33_ojai.note: Only spring/fall season words for Wheeler Gorge and summer heat at Sespe; no months named.

mn_interstate_state_park_bouldering.name: Interstate State Park Bouldering
mn_interstate_state_park_bouldering.note: Sources give 'late spring to early fall' as words only; no months named.

oh_marne_road.name: Marne Road
oh_marne_road.note: Only 'fall through spring' season words for Ohio bouldering; no months, nothing Marne-specific.

ut_ibex.name: Ibex
ut_ibex.note: KAYA: bouldering season late fall to mid spring, Nov-Apr (from search snippet); SummitPost: summer typically too hot at Ibex.

ca_potter_s_point_2.name: Potter's Point
ca_potter_s_point_2.note: Only spring/fall words and summer sun warnings; no months named.

co_staunton_rocks.name: Staunton Rocks
co_staunton_rocks.note: Guidebook summary says summer and fall best, words only; no months named.

co_monastery_the.name: Monastery, The
co_monastery_the.note: Only 'spring through fall' for a neighbouring crag; no months for the Monastery.

wa_sunshine_wall.name: Sunshine Wall
wa_sunshine_wall.note: HELD by reviewer: sources name spring only; Frenchman Coulee also climbs in fall, so a spring-only window would mislead. Frenchman Coulee: late March through early May best (visit guide); a climbing page also says spring best; summer unbearable on this sunny wall. Sources speak for the Frenchman system; fall/mild winter possible but no months named.

ar_sam_s_throne_surroundings.name: Sam's Throne & Surroundings
ar_sam_s_throne_surroundings.note: No month-naming source; one site lists every month, forum notes cold winter climbing.

co_escalante_canyon.name: Escalante Canyon
co_escalante_canyon.note: Skyward (its Escalante page redirects to the Grand Junction page) names Feb-Jun and Sep-Nov; cliffs mostly south-facing so cooler temperatures are best.

ca_valley_south_side.name: Valley South Side
ca_valley_south_side.note: Valley primer: mid-March to mid-May and mid-Sept to mid-Nov; guide-written overview and MadBoulder agree spring and fall (valley-wide, not South Side specific).

co_morrison_boulders.name: Morrison Boulders
co_morrison_boulders.note: Adventure Collective names Mar-May and Sep-Nov; Westword adds winter is also workable on warm days; summer storms/heat the drawback.

co_area_a.name: Area A
co_area_a.note: Only road-opening dates and 'summer prime' words at altitude; a road window is not a climbing season; no month-naming climbing source.

co_lime_park_a_k_a_lime_creek.name: Lime Park (a.k.a. Lime Creek)
co_lime_park_a_k_a_lime_creek.note: No useful season source; only an all-months listing and closure notes.

id_dierkes_lake.name: Dierkes Lake
id_dierkes_lake.note: One forum remark that it is the warmest winter spot in S. Idaho; no month-naming sources.
